title: Phenol-chloroform DNA extraction from Sporosarcina pasteurii
author: Michael S. Carter

steps.title: Culture Sporosarcina pasteurii
steps.instruction: Grow Sporosarcina pasteurii cells in 150 mL of BHI/330 mM urea at 30°C with 200 rpm shaking until an OD600 of 3.5 is reached.

steps.title: Concentrate and Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest the cells and resuspend them in Resuspension Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Concentrate cells by centrifugation at 15,000 x g for 10 min
Pour off the supernatant
Resuspend cells in 10 mL of Resuspension Buffer (50 mM Tris pH 8.0, 10% sucrose)

steps.title: Lyse Cells and Stabilize DNA
steps.instruction: Add lysis reagents to the cell suspension and incubate to break down cells.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.5 mL Lysis Buffer (Tris pH 8.0, 10 mg/mL lysozyme)
Add 1.5 mL 10% SDS
Add 5 µL 100 mg/mL RNase A
Add 25 µL 50 mg/mL proteinase K
Incubate for 1 h at 37°C

steps.title: Precipitate and Spool DNA
steps.instruction: Separate DNA from other biomacromolecules via precipitation and manual recovery.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.3 mL of 3.0 M sodium acetate (pH 5.5) and 30 mL of 100% ethanol
Spool DNA onto a glass hook
Transfer spooled DNA to 20 mL of TE buffer
Dissolve DNA in TE buffer for 1 h at 37°C

steps.title: Perform Phenol-Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Purify DNA using a phenol-chloroform-isoamyl alcohol mixture.

substeps.instruction: Add a 5 mL aliquot of DNA to 7 mL of phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1, Saturated with 10mM Tris, pH 8.0, 1mM EDTA)
Mix by inversion
Centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 10 min to separate phases

steps.title: Perform Chloroform Wash
steps.instruction: Further purify the aqueous phase using chloroform.

substeps.instruction: Pipette off the aqueous phase and add to 5 mL of chloroform
Mix by vortexing
Centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 10 min to separate phases

steps.title: Final DNA Precipitation and Wash
steps.instruction: Recover the purified DNA through ethanol precipitation and washing.

substeps.instruction: Pipette off the aqueous phase and add to 30 mL of 100% ethanol
Mix by inversion
Collect precipitated DNA by centrifugation at 10,000 x g for 10 min
Wash pelleted DNA twice by adding 5 mL of 70% ethanol, mixing by inversion, centrifuging at 10,000 x g for 5 min, and removing the supernatant

steps.title: Dissolve Final DNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final purified DNA pellet in TE buffer.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve the final pellet in 500 µL of TE buffer at 37°C for 1 h
